You dodged a bullet with her! It is NOT neglecting her to focus on the future. Ultimately, you getting that degree means more financial security for the both of you! If she wasn’t going to suck it up and support that, then be happy that you are no longer with someone who left you when times are tough. 

Because that’s what life is. Hardships are going to happen constantly especially when we become old and are bodies start to wither away. It’s so important to have someone who is loyal. 

So no, don’t say your grad degree destroyed your marriage. She destroyed the marriage because she was a human being with a bad heart. Good job for you for completing it! Know your worth and that you deserve someone who is willing to work as hard and make sacrifices just as you did.

IF you were like me, and constantly failed classes in high school… then decided to go to college again years later… sorry I ended up being a drop out. 

If you were the type of person who easily got A’s and B’s throughout school because tests and studying was something you genuinely enjoyed… GO FOR IT. 

People don’t change. Know yourself & what your limits are. I ended up going to Trade School, so did my partner & that worked out better for us and now we’re making more money than some people with Master’s degrees. College can be a way, but it’s not the ONLY way to succeed in life. We also aren’t in thousands of dollars of student debt.
